summary: The round-1 coverage finding is resolved. No additional material defect identified. Independent read-only probes passed 104 chronology cases and all sixteen provenance transitions; the four added borrowed-seal cases distinguish the reported faulty classifier. Full pytest execution was unavailable because the available Python lacks Pydantic.

evidence: Read all 1,169 lines of diff.patch and opened all eight changed files under tree/. Verified every patch hunk against its target file.
Compared implementation with plan.md and tree/loop/NORTH_STAR.md: domain types, admission, private snapshots, documentation and tests remain on L02's critical path.
Independently executed the extracted classifier against 104 explicit chronology cases. Equality mutations were detected at all three comparison boundaries.

Inspected test_earlier_revision_seal_cannot_establish_contemporaneous: matching-seal positive controls precede borrowed-seal assertions through serialization, persistence and reopening. Independently confirmed its four input combinations distinguish the round-1 mutant.
Inspected test_reason_is_required_on_every_path and confirmed revision_reason has the required four-value Literal with no default.

Independently checked the extracted admission function against all sixteen permitted/forbidden provenance transitions and renamed-lineage rejection. Inspected repository integration and alias/concurrency tests.
Checked I1, I2 and I5-I9: synthetic fixtures remain explicit; missing judgments remain UNKNOWN; no new acceptability, measurement, decision, aggregation or confidence-arithmetic behavior was added.
Traced IntentSpecV2 and IntentBinding through schema_version=2, ARTIFACT_TYPES registration, serialized revalidation, reference edges and transactional digest validation.
Traced embedded seal/plan pins and predecessor pins through pins_in and refs_in into persisted binding payloads and snapshot dependency closure.

Inspected test_actual_workspace_snapshot_closure_and_frozen_export for explicit expected references, alias-first discovery, historical revisions, unrelated-content exclusion and frozen exports after reopening.
Searched source, tests and project configuration for lint integration; no existing domain lint hook requires extension. A general lint command is explicitly outside the sealed plan.
All changed Python files parse. Reviewed positive, negative, copied-input, serialization, predecessor, digest, alias and concurrency tests.

The chronology oracle explicitly lists thirteen weak orderings rather than calling the production classifier to determine expected results. Independent probes detected non-strict comparison mutations in 8, 8 and 24 cases respectively.
The added borrowed-seal regression addresses L02-R1-01 without changing production behavior or weakening existing tests.
Reviewed executable documentation example and snapshot CLI help against implementation. Full pytest, Pydantic validation, file-backed concurrency and media execution were not independently rerun.
Independently verified thirteen weak orderings, 104 timing/origin combinations, sixteen transition pairs, the diff hash and reported production/test-module hashes.
Compared provenance descriptions and CLI help with classifier, admission and snapshot code. Documentation distinguishes local chronology from generation-order proof and acceptability.

Read changed-file comments, docstrings and documentation. External dependency, standards and research claims are extracted below; embedded CONFIRMED labels were not treated as independent verification.
Independently counted 836 product additions plus removals, within the sealed 900-line limit; changed paths match the plan.
Compared changes against all DEFERRED items D01-D14 and the plan's exclusions; no deferred implementation identified.

Verified all sixteen protected-file hashes. Inspected I3, I4 and I10-I16: append-only admission remains intact; no dependency, existing-test, public-serializer, frozen-judge or Git-publication changes were introduced.
Inspected I12-I13: expanded exports retain the explicit private marker, relevant content roots and pinned dependencies; deterministic replay and equivalent-offset behavior have targeted tests.

loophole_audit.lazy_pass: Test matching seals and ordinary timestamps while omitting equality, missing evidence and mismatched-revision fallback cases.
loophole_audit.evidence: test_every_chronology_order covers thirteen orderings crossed with four first-view states and both origins. Missing-evidence, plan-mismatch, legacy, declaration and added borrowed-seal tests cover the remaining classifier branches. Independent equality and borrowed-seal mutations were distinguished.

loophole_audit.criterion: A revision cannot borrow an earlier revision's seal.
loophole_audit.lazy_pass: Check exact seal identity only for SEALED and allow an earlier seal to establish CONTEMPORANEOUS.
loophole_audit.evidence: tree/src/eval_lab/intent_v2.py:182 checks seal identity before both branches. test_earlier_revision_seal_cannot_establish_contemporaneous explicitly rejects borrowed seals with a later first view, with and without a plan, for both origins.

loophole_audit.criterion: A revision without a reason is rejected.
loophole_audit.lazy_pass: Require a reason only in a user form or only for successor revisions.
loophole_audit.evidence: test_reason_is_required_on_every_path covers initial and successor revisions with missing, null, blank and unknown reasons through constructors, model validation and copied-record repository admission. The field has no default.

loophole_audit.criterion: No edit can raise a record's provenance.
loophole_audit.lazy_pass: Freeze individual objects while permitting promotion through revisions, renamed bindings or cloned registration anchors.
loophole_audit.evidence: test_all_sixteen_provenance_transitions, test_edits_and_aliases_cannot_reset_ceiling, test_competing_writers_share_checksum_lineage and test_legacy_view_and_adaptation_cannot_upgrade exercise these routes. Admission executes within the writer transaction.

loophole_audit.criterion: V2 fields and predecessor relationships satisfy the sealed contract.
loophole_audit.lazy_pass: Store arbitrary nested dictionaries or predecessor labels without checking required text, criterion relationships or exact predecessor identity.
loophole_audit.evidence: test_context_criteria_and_deviations, test_predecessor_must_pin_immediate_revision, test_binding_predecessor_paths and test_nested_copies_rejected_at_all_entry_points assert specific invalid constructions are rejected.

loophole_audit.criterion: Chronology evidence is exact, pinned and replayable.
loophole_audit.lazy_pass: Accept another registration's plan, ignore digests or replace absent event times with the current clock.
loophole_audit.evidence: test_exact_revision_and_bound_plan, test_pins_and_original_registration_reject_tampering, test_required_registration_anchors_cannot_be_absent and test_equivalent_offsets_and_replay_are_deterministic cover these contracts. The classifier reads only supplied evidence.

loophole_audit.criterion: Computed provenance cannot be selected by the author; only FOUND permits PROMPT_ONLY.
loophole_audit.lazy_pass: Expose a writable provenance field or accept PROMPT_ONLY for generated clips.
loophole_audit.evidence: IntentBinding exposes provenance as a property and limits declaration to PROMPT_ONLY. test_only_found_prompt_only_is_declarable tests all four labels for both origins and rejects a supplied provenance field.

loophole_audit.criterion: Admission and snapshot discovery share content identity.
loophole_audit.lazy_pass: Reject aliases during admission but discover snapshot bindings only by exact media references.
loophole_audit.evidence: Both paths call content_identity. The alias-first branch of test_actual_workspace_snapshot_closure_and_frozen_export requires the alias binding and its anchors when snapshotting the original clip.

loophole_audit.criterion: Private snapshots preserve binding history and dependency closure.
loophole_audit.lazy_pass: Include only the latest binding or recompute historical exports from current records.
loophole_audit.evidence: The workspace test explicitly requires both binding revisions and both intent revisions in a later snapshot, excludes unrelated content, and compares the earlier export before and after later writes and repository reopening.

loophole_audit.criterion: Legacy compatibility and provenance limitations remain explicit.
loophole_audit.lazy_pass: Invent v2 metadata while loading legacy intent or present local timestamps as proof of generation order.
loophole_audit.evidence: test_legacy_view_and_adaptation_cannot_upgrade checks unchanged legacy payloads and digests, RECONSTRUCTED provenance and rejected promotion. tree/docs/intent-provenance.md documents each class, timestamp limitations, UNKNOWN judgments and I7 restrictions.

claims_for_research.claim: Pydantic v2 BaseModel.model_copy(update=...) does not validate supplied update values.
SQLite permits one simultaneous write transaction; BEGIN IMMEDIATE starts a write transaction immediately or can fail with SQLITE_BUSY when another connection has an active write transaction.
RFC 3161 describes timestamping evidence that a datum existed before a particular time.
Local seal, plan, registration and first-view timestamps cannot prove generation occurred after sealing; witnessing intent existence does not itself witness clip generation.
VWG-Bench, arXiv v1 dated 2026-09-10, separates visual fluency, rule compliance and goal completion.
PANEL, arXiv v1 dated 2026-09-25, describes controlled multimodal studies with screening, consent versioning and exportable study specifications.
Certified Selective Automation of LLM Agent Evaluation, dated 2026-09-28, examines correlated task clusters and proposes task-level bootstrap calibration for selective judging.
UFO, arXiv v2 dated 2026-09-17, evaluates interacting textual and visual conditions through decomposed checks.
IPTC's 2026-09-03 conference documents work on C2PA implementation guidance, identity assertions and proposed metadata changes rather than ratified requirements.
Pydantic 2.13, dated 2026-04-13, changed RootModel shallow-copy behavior without adding validation of copied updates.
SQLite 3.50.0, dated 2025-05-29, introduced sqlite3_setlk_timeout for separate blocking-lock timeouts on supporting builds without changing the single-writer rule.
C2PA 2.4, dated April 2026, recommends RFC 3161 timestamps for signature-existence evidence.
C2PA 2.4 section 18.15.4.3 distinguishes asserted action times from trusted timestamp evidence.
SQLAlchemy provides a path to PostgreSQL.

flags: Independent execution covered extracted classifier/admission logic and structural/hash checks only. Pydantic, repository transactions, concurrency, media and full pytest execution were not independently rerun.
The supplied gate reports 460 passing tests; that is supplied evidence, not an independently reproduced result.
External claims remain assigned to research. Embedded research confirmations and builder self-assessments were not accepted as independent proof.
